nodes.title: New email
nodes.desc: Fires when a new email lands in the inbox you connected to WorkBuddy.

nodes.title: Email agent
nodes.desc: WorkBuddy reads the email, pulls out who sent it, what they want and any dates or amounts.

nodes.title: Classifier
nodes.desc: Sorts each email into Bill, Customer or Ignore. Only Bill and Customer emails reach the widget.

nodes.title: JSON data
nodes.desc: The sorted emails are written as JSON for the board to read.

nodes.title: Email agent
nodes.desc: Shows how many emails need a reply and lists the urgent ones.

nodes.title: AI model
nodes.desc: The language model the agent uses to read the email.

nodes.title: Sender memory
nodes.desc: Remembers who your regular suppliers and customers are so sorting improves.
